title: Discovery of novel CSF biomarkers to predict progression in dementia using machine learning
summary: The authors report group classification and candidate prioritization, while stating that no candidate is a strong individual predictor. The proteins are exploratory biomarkers; the source does not establish individual-level prognostic accuracy or clinical utility.
ai_technology: Random forests analyze cerebrospinal-fluid proteomics to classify fast versus slow dementia progression and prioritize TNFRSF4 and TGF-β1 candidates.
